title: Gurgaon Disputed Notice Period Penalty
user_prompt: I rented a flat in Sector 48 Gurgaon. I gave 1 month written notice on email on 1st July and vacated 31st July. Deposit was 120000. Landlord cut 45000 saying orally he told me notice period is 2 months, so he deducted 1 month rent as penalty for sudden vacancy. Our written agreement clearly says 1 month notice by either party.
